buildings.name: Guild Hall
buildings.description: The heart of the guild. Its level anchors the rest of the guild headquarters.
buildings.unlockSummary: Higher levels unlock access to advanced guild buildings.

benefits.title: Guild Headquarters
benefits.description: The guild can manage missions, supplies, and construction.

benefits.title: Support Buildings
benefits.description: Workshop and Treasury become available.

benefits.title: Combat Infrastructure
benefits.description: Raid Hall, Training Grounds, and Essence Sanctum become available.

benefits.title: War Planning
benefits.description: War Room becomes available.

buildings.name: Mission Board
buildings.description: Improves weekly mission selection, daily orders, and guild mission rewards.
buildings.unlockSummary: Improves guild mission variety and rewards.

benefits.title: Mission Infrastructure
benefits.description: Unlocks mission reward bonuses and keeps the mission system active.

benefits.title: Mission Variety
benefits.description: Adds a fourth weekly mission option when enough definitions are available.

benefits.title: Improved Orders
benefits.description: Adds a fourth personal daily order when enough definitions are available.

benefits.title: Premium Contracts
benefits.description: Personal and weekly mission currency, XP, and supply rewards gain the full board bonus.

buildings.name: Market Office
buildings.description: Unlocks and improves the guild shop.
buildings.unlockSummary: Unlocks common, weekly, and prestige shop stock by level.

benefits.title: Common Stock
benefits.description: Common guild shop stock can be purchased.

benefits.title: Expanded Stock
benefits.description: Additional common stock appears in the shop.

benefits.title: Weekly Stock
benefits.description: Rotating weekly shop stock becomes available.

benefits.title: Prestige Procurement
benefits.description: Prestige stock becomes available.

buildings.name: Raid Hall
buildings.description: Prepares the guild for cooperative raid content.
buildings.unlockSummary: Unlock placeholder for future guild raids.

benefits.title: Raid Readiness
benefits.description: Unlocks the Raids tab locked state and prepares future raid registration.

benefits.title: Raid Registration
benefits.description: Planned support for opening raid sign-ups.

benefits.title: Raid Coordination
benefits.description: Planned support for raid contribution scoring.

benefits.title: Raid Spoils
benefits.description: Planned support for improved raid rewards.

buildings.name: War Room
buildings.description: Prepares the guild for future war registration and war planning.
buildings.unlockSummary: Unlock placeholder for future guild wars.

benefits.title: War Planning
benefits.description: Unlocks the Wars tab locked state and prepares future war registration.

benefits.title: Roster Planning
benefits.description: Planned support for war roster setup.

benefits.title: Defense Planning
benefits.description: Planned support for defense preparation.

benefits.title: Season Strategy
benefits.description: Planned support for seasonal war progression.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.unlockSummary: Adds crafting-flavored mission and shop support.

benefits.title: Craft Orders
benefits.description: Crafting and tempering guild orders can appear from the data-driven order pool.

benefits.title: Workshop Stock
benefits.description: Workshop-themed shop stock can be configured through guild content data.

benefits.title: Supply Efficiency
benefits.description: Planned support for crafting-related Guild Supply bonuses.

benefits.title: Masterwork Support
benefits.description: Planned support for high-tier crafting objectives.

buildings.name: Training Grounds
buildings.description: Supports future raid and war preparation.
buildings.unlockSummary: Future raid and war support effects.

benefits.title: Training Yard
benefits.description: Unlocks the building foundation for combat preparation systems.

benefits.title: Raid Drills
benefits.description: Planned support for raid preparation bonuses.

benefits.title: War Drills
benefits.description: Planned support for war preparation bonuses.

benefits.title: Veteran Training
benefits.description: Planned support for advanced combat guild objectives.

benefits.title: Essence Infrastructure
benefits.description: Unlocks the building foundation for essence-focused guild systems.

benefits.title: Essence Orders
benefits.description: Planned support for essence guild objectives.

benefits.title: Essence Rewards
benefits.description: Planned support for essence-themed guild rewards.

benefits.title: Sanctum Rituals
benefits.description: Planned support for advanced essence progression.

buildings.name: Treasury
buildings.unlockSummary: Reduces building Guild Supply costs and construction time.

benefits.title: Supply Ledger
benefits.description: Treasury level reduces building Guild Supply costs by 2% per level.

benefits.title: Supply Storage
benefits.description: Guild Supply handling is represented through construction efficiency.

benefits.title: Construction Efficiency
benefits.description: Treasury level reduces building construction time by 2% per level.

benefits.title: Quartermaster Network
benefits.description: Treasury efficiency reaches its current maximum.

weeklyMissions.description: Clear dungeon rooms together as a guild.

weeklyMissions.description: Complete tempering actions together as a guild.

weeklyMissions.description: Craft items together as a guild.

weeklyMissions.description: Complete dungeon runs together as a guild.

dailyOrders.name: Cull the Wilds
dailyOrders.description: Defeat 100 creatures while in a guild.

shopItems.description: A practical packet of Cinders for everyday upgrades.

shopItems.name: Cinder Satchel

shopItems.name: Builder's Crate
shopItems.description: A weekly support crate for active guild contributors.

shopItems.name: Soulstone Bundle
shopItems.description: A rotating bundle for members who kept the weekly ledger moving.

shopItems.name: Echo Stipend
shopItems.description: A focused weekly stipend for prophecy and fate planning.

shopItems.name: Honor Reliquary

shopItems.name: Elder Cache
